heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1S handles Sunlu PETG effortlessly out of the box using its stock stainless steel nozzle, achieving reliable print speeds up to 179 mm/s at a 15 mm³/s maximum volumetric flow rate. For optimal results, keep the enclosure door cracked or the top glass propped open during extended prints to avoid heat creep.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate (no adhesive required) or Smooth PEI Plate with Glue Stick as a release agent
slicerTweaks: Set Maximum Volumetric Speed to 15 mm³/s under Filament > Advanced to prevent under-extrusion at high speeds.
Turn off or limit the Auxiliary Part Cooling Fan to 0-10% to eliminate asymmetrical shrinkage and part warping.
Enable 'Wipe while retracting' with a 2mm distance to reduce nozzle accumulation and whisker stringing.
Calibrate Pressure Advance in OrcaSlicer to approximately 0.036-0.042 to ensure crisp corners without corner bulging.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Fine stringing and whisker formation across travel paths
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Filament moisture absorption and residual nozzle pressure during non-print travel moves.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry filament at 65°C for 6 to 8 hours, enable retraction wipe in OrcaSlicer, and adjust nozzle temperature to 238-240°C.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Build plate damage or extreme tear-out on smooth sheets
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PETG forms an aggressive molecular bond directly onto smooth PEI surfaces without a sacrificial barrier.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Use a Bambu Textured PEI plate or apply a uniform layer of PVA glue stick as a release agent before printing.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Extruder gear clicking and heat creep clog during long prints
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: High internal chamber temperature from the 78°C bed softens PETG in the direct drive cold zone.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Prop open the top glass cover or leave the front door ajar during prints to maintain chamber temperature below 38°C.

faq.question: Should I keep the P1S door and top glass closed when printing Sunlu PETG?
faq.answer: It is recommended to vent the enclosure by cracking the front door or propping the top lid, which prevents chamber heat creep and gear jamming.

faq.question: Does Sunlu PETG require an upgrade to a hardened steel nozzle on the P1S?
faq.answer: No, standard Sunlu PETG is non-abrasive and the stock stainless steel nozzle on the P1S provides full operational lifespan and performance.

faq.question: Why are my PETG prints warping off the plate on the auxiliary fan side?
faq.answer: The P1S auxiliary fan creates rapid, uneven cooling on PETG; set the auxiliary fan speed to 0% in OrcaSlicer cooling parameters.

faq.question: What should I do if my Sunlu PETG prints are making popping sounds and bubbling?
faq.answer: The material has absorbed ambient moisture; dry the spool thoroughly in a dedicated filament dryer at 65°C for 6-8 hours before use.
